c1.evidence: N26 is a real operating digital bank (German banking license), but it has no US offering whatsoever — real company, wrong market.

c2.evidence: No US product or offer page exists: N26's official account-availability page (support.n26.com) lists 21 European countries only — the US is absent.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee is documented for a product that does not exist for US users.

c4.evidence: No concrete payout or bonus exists in official terms for US users because N26 discontinued its US operations; there is no official offer to anchor any amount to.

s1.note: Eligibility documented on N26's official support page: accounts available only in Austria, Belgium, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, and Switzerland — the US is not eligible.

s2.note: No US fee schedule exists; nothing to verify.

s3.note: No payout timing exists; nothing to verify.

s4.note: The catalog claim ('check for signup bonus') is concrete but cannot be anchored to any official N26 US terms because the US product is gone.

s5.note: https://support.n26.com/en-eu/account-and-personal-details/opening-an-account/can-i-open-an-n26-account-in-my-country — official N26 support page loaded live; US absent from the availability list.

s6.note: No steps given: the product does not exist for US users (reject).

eligibility: US residents cannot open N26 accounts. N26 accounts are available only to residents of the 21 European countries listed on N26's official support page.
biggest_catch: N26 has no US product at all — it discontinued its US operations on January 11, 2022, and has not returned.
catches: N26 announced on November 18, 2021 that its US operations would end after January 11, 2022; ~500,000 US customers were wound down (official N26 press statement, hosted on N26's own Contentful asset host).
N26's official account-availability page lists only European countries; the US is not among them.
There is no N26 signup bonus for US users because there is no US product to sign up for.
n26.com's US site (previously n26.com/en-us) no longer exists.
notes: Checked 2026-09-22/23. N26 exited the US years ago per its own official announcement; its current official availability page confirms the US is excluded. This route is not a candidate for any bonus — a US user cannot even open the account. App links left null.
